name: clean-hack-installer
description: This code installs and sets up various tools for ethical hacking and penetration testing. The tools include Metasploit, sqlmap, Nmap, Wireshark, the Social Engineer Toolkit, and Wifite2. The code also installs dependencies and sets up proxychains and tor for anonymous browsing.

name: metasploit-auto-installer-tool
description: This script installs the Metasploit framework on a system running the Ubuntu operating system. The Metasploit framework is a powerful tool used for developing and executing exploits against a target system.

name: PhoneSploit-Pro
description: A hacking tool to remotely exploit Android devices using ADB and get a Meterpreter session.
